explanation.question_quote: On physical exam, the patient has low-set ears, upslanting palpebral fissures, and a hypoplastic fifth finger.
explanation.sentence: The newborn has low-set ears, upslanting palpebral fissures, and a hypoplastic fifth finger.
This combination of physical findings, together with advanced maternal age, suggests Down syndrome (trisomy 21).
A complete atrioventricular septal defect is the congenital heart defect most characteristic of Down syndrome among the options listed.
